Sucks.. ★☆☆☆☆

I really wanted to like this app, but it’s become more frustrating than enjoyable. It runs very slowly, and after using it for a few minutes my phone gets noticeably hot. Almost every feature seems to push you toward making a purchase, which takes away from the experience. Some of the games also feel intentionally difficult unless you watch long ads or spend your gems to progress. Instead of rewarding skill and time, it often feels like the app is trying to monetize every step. I hope the developers focus on improving performance and making the gameplay feel fairer. If I could’ve put no stars I would have. Thank you and goodbye.

reviews.text: Ads and some game mechanics. I’d like to start, I do love this app. I do. My boyfriend and I have had these two lil guys for just over 2 years now and it’s a joy to have our “kids”. Lately the ads are getting out of control, I understand ads in the arcade games or when you want to get coins or whatever. But you love one kid, ads. Feed the other, ads. And sometimes I wouldn’t care, but when there hearts and food meters deplete at such an exponential pace that is much faster than it was 2 years ago, lately it’s been quicker than even 2 months ago. They are constantly almost on the brink of death and I literally just checked on them like an hour and a half prior. And now with the food, I can buy so much and they eat SO MUCH and then you get lil coins when you feed, love, or pet them but now you barely get any coins back on basically the 60 coins worth of food you just gave to them and they were up to over a thousand coins each and now they are scraping by at only 100 even though I just got so many coins just earlier in the month. It’s just really frustrating that this game has changed so much in mechanics because they just want you to buy the stuff to keep them alive. And I’m not talking about the coins. “Buy this pengu plus” “buy this thing that’ll fill all their hearts up” “don’t want ads? Buy this” “don’t want them to die? Buy this”. It’s just way to much and I know the developers need to make money in order to keep this app going but your doing too much. It is almost as bad as bitlife and that’s saying something. And a big bug this game has is when your phone is on low battery mode, a little popup comes up in the app that tells you that, great! Only thing is it completely freezes the app and doesn’t allow you to do anything. You can refresh the app all you want but until you turn off low power mode, you can’t get in and use the app. In summary: love the game, but the rate of losing food,love, and coins is a lot, there’s too many ads, the semisubtle push to in game purchases is obnoxious, and a big bug with low battery mode freezes the game. Update: so I wrote the initial review like a month and a half ago, just now realized I didn’t press send. Super duper funny awesome amazing thing that has happened in that time. It’s gotten worse. Oh. My. Goodness. The love, draining faster than ever, their good level also draining. Yk how I mentioned that the cost of everything and not receiving much coins back after feeding them? Yea we are almost broke get again and I just got their money up in the time that I last wrote. And the ads. How are the ads that pop up even worse. Like I get that you want us to purchase the pengu pass. But the pressure you are forcing to have to get the pass for this to be even remotely enjoyable like it was before. I get that I could just delete this app and forget about it, I have had these two for over two years now. I genuinely have grown an attachment to them but this is seriously ridiculous. I’m not sure if the developers even care at this point since the gist of reviews I’ve seen have had similar issues with the ads, the pressure to buy extra stuff, having bugs that are not being addressed. And getting NOTHING from support. It’s really upsetting how little it seems they care. Again I really love this app it is just so upsetting watching something I’ve grown so fond of to slowly deteriorate. I don’t know if you know this but the more you the developers keep accelerating this, the more players you are going to lose because many people don’t play things like bitlife for many of the same issues.
